scope: Analysis only; no guest, compiler, scheduler, workload or demo changes. Passive markers are checked against emitted Action! instructions and complete linked Calypsi sections. CPU charge excludes native interrupts and other Tasks, includes bus stalls and kernel/C tails. Nested inclusive costs must not be added. Endpoints at RTL exclude that instruction; C call-site spans include JSL through its return continuation.
limitations: This diagnoses the current implementation; it is not an A/B attribution of the previous HY4 regression.
The raw-pointer cohort was not rerun; its separately measured off-CPU delay is not resolved here.
No latency gate or transient-pixel artifact has been fixed.
Input-service gaps are gaps between service entries, not complete capture-to-commit or capture-to-scanout latency bounds.
Startup/setup and full-redraw comparison maxima are kept separate from the three measured gesture windows.
